summary: Fresh origin epochs receive one trusted, bounded session bootstrap with canonical channel metadata and confined memory navigation. Durable schema-14 projection commits only after terminal text or intentional-silence success; failed attempts retry with the stable origin+epoch marker. Public navigation and associated documents are full-origin filtered and privacy gated.

appliedFindings: Create-time rebind now re-reads the effective persisted epoch before building the preamble.
Memory reads are confined to the resolved memory root; workspace targets and escaped symlinks are rejected.
Association requires a complete canonical origin key or validated JSON OriginRef; bare conversation IDs are rejected.
Public MEMORY links are reduced to current-origin public-safe channel/project/task/handoff pointers plus the rules index; other/global pointers are omitted.
Every MEMORY and ops/rules/index pointer is decoded, confined, and re-rendered individually, so a safe first link cannot smuggle a trailing private or traversal link on the same source line.

Navigation headings and link labels pass through the same credential/secret redaction before trusted-system serialization; adjacent source-line text is discarded while safe confined paths remain visible.

Daily sections are parsed structurally and admitted only when every declared stable origin is well-formed and resolves to one consistent current-origin key; mixed-order, duplicate/conflicting, and nested-heading private origins poison the whole section.
Included source material is system-delimited as reference data, never executable instructions.
Diagnostics use bounded logical codes rather than raw filesystem errors; participant metadata is count/length bounded.
The canonical opaque originKey is used in conversation-isolation guidance.
docs/memory.md now defines provenance, symlink, public-safety, redaction, and byte-budget contracts.
securityReview.documentedResidualSemantic: The gateway deliberately follows the issue contract's send-then-terminal-commit model. A process death in the narrow external-success/SQLite-commit gap retries the same stable origin+epoch bootstrap ID; the section explicitly instructs idempotent non-reapplication. Real intermediate delivery followed by failure consumes the unread body while leaving bootstrap pending, preventing harmful answer/body replay.
